name: Law Justice
tagline: Purple and blue legal deck with institutional photo overlays, white frames, courthouse marks, and formal centered typography.

palette.description: Magenta-to-indigo overlay over grayscale institutional backgrounds with thin white frame rules.

typography.style: Clean formal sans for titles, with Libre Baskerville reserved for quotes and testimony.

best_for: Legal briefings, justice policy updates, public institution presentations, and law education decks.
avoid_for: Playful, youth, consumer, or warm nonprofit contexts.

source_inspiration.name: SlidesCarnival Stylish Law and Justice Template
source_inspiration.notes: Source-inspired HTML/CSS template rebuilt from public visual reference only; not a pixel copy and does not reuse source assets.
